Given that $M$ is the midpoint of $\overset{―}{LN}$ with $LM=7-x$ and $LN=11-x$, what is the value of $LN?$
question.worked_solution:
We have the following diagram.

![](/home/jake/Developer/Course_Academy/reference/mathacademy/capture/linear/14233096/assets/7c89598fe6a0450eddfe8af4ed274d4110fd7cb2de796bb5a749798b44c7e94a.png)

  

Since $M$ is the midpoint of $\overset{―}{LN}$, the segment $\overset{―}{LN}$ is twice the length of the segment $\overset{―}{LM}.$ So, we have:

$$
\begin{aligned}2LM & =LN \\ 2(7-x) & =11-x \\ 14-2x & =11-x \\ 14-2x+2x & =11-x+2x \\ 14 & =11+x \\ 14-11 & =11+x-11 \\ 3 & =x \\ x & =3\end{aligned}
$$

Therefore,  by plugging this value into the expression for $LN$, we obtain:

$$
\begin{aligned}LN & =11-x \\  & =11-3 \\  & =8\end{aligned}
$$
